# EveryCentCalc

> 28 free financial calculators for freelancers, side hustlers, real estate investors, and small business owners. Updated for 2026 IRS tax brackets.

## What This Site Does

EveryCentCalc provides free online financial calculators. All calculations happen in the browser — no data is stored or transmitted.

- **Freelance & Self-Employment Tax**: Self-employment tax, quarterly estimates, side hustle tax, freelance income tax, tax deductions, quarterly deadlines
- **Freelance Business**: Freelancer rate calculator, profitability calculator, retirement savings calculator
- **Side Hustle & Gig Economy**: Etsy profit, rideshare driver income, freelance vs employment, debt payoff, time tracking value
- **Real Estate Investing**: Rent vs buy, rental property, house flipping, rental cash flow, mortgage payment
- **LLC & Business Entity Tax**: LLC vs sole proprietor, S-Corp tax, business entity comparison
- **Business Finance**: Break-even, startup runway, profit margin, business debt payoff, SaaS metrics
- **Investment & Retirement**: Compound interest, required minimum distributions, Roth conversion, 401(k)

## Key Facts

- **28 calculators** across 7 categories
- **2026 IRS tax brackets** and rates used for all tax calculations
- **100% free** — no accounts, no paywalls
- **100% private** — all calculations client-side
- Based in the US market, targeting freelancers, side hustlers, and small business owners

## Calculator URLs

All calculators are at: `https://everycentcalc.biz.id/calculator/{calculator-slug}/`
